name: Confused Love - ṭhex khụ̄x dāw bn f̂ā yām rātrī
original_name: Confused Love - เธอคือดาวบนฟ้ายามราตรี
source:
Summary : Wut (the protagonist) lost his mom and dad in a car accident. After the incident, his aunt June decided to take him in and raise him in her home in a rural area. This move also made him to transfer to a new school. When Wut is young, Wut used to visit this place and had lots of friends, but that was a long time ago. Will this move bring Wut to be with his childhood friends again? And what situation Wut will be in. It’s up to you to decide how the story will end.
